Reason: Comparing Figure 1 (extensive left lung consolidation) to Figure 2 shows a decrease in the original left-sided opacity but the appearance of new consolidations in the right upper lobe and left lower zone. This shifting or "migratory" pattern of pulmonary infiltrates is a hallmark radiographic feature supporting the diagnosis of cryptogenic organizing pneumonia.
